plan.goal: Understand and begin structured work on Mozart.
globalAcceptanceCriteria: The repo has an active project profile.
The initial architecture and workflow are documented in task memory.
The next implementation-ready task can be selected deterministically.

tasks.title: Map repository structure
tasks.description: Inspect Mozart and identify the main modules, entrypoints, and important directories.
acceptanceCriteria: Key directories and subsystem boundaries are summarized.

tasks.title: Review active profile
tasks.description: Confirm that the TypeScript Node Service profile matches the repo's build and validation workflow.
acceptanceCriteria: The chosen profile is validated or adjusted.

tasks.title: Seed project-specific execution plan
tasks.description: Break the repo's immediate roadmap into concrete tasks with dependencies and acceptance criteria.
acceptanceCriteria: There is at least one ready implementation or validation task.

tasks.title: Run baseline validation
tasks.description: Execute the profile's validation commands to establish the current repo baseline.

tasks.title: Write architecture summary
tasks.description: Summarize the main subsystems in Mozart, starting from src/bootstrap.ts and the detected manifests.
acceptanceCriteria: The main modules and responsibilities are documented.

tasks.title: Review validation baseline
tasks.description: Inspect the active profile commands and package.json to capture what currently passes, fails, or is missing.
acceptanceCriteria: Validation outcomes are summarized with follow-up actions.

tasks.title: Define first work slice
tasks.description: Choose the first implementation-ready slice inside Mozart, starting from src/bootstrap.ts, and break it into concrete subtasks.
acceptanceCriteria: At least one project-specific implementation task is ready.

tasks.title: Implement first slice in src/bootstrap.ts
tasks.description: Make the first bounded implementation improvement in src/bootstrap.ts.
acceptanceCriteria: A small implementation change is prepared for review.

tasks.title: Review first slice in src/bootstrap.ts
tasks.description: Review the first implementation slice for src/bootstrap.ts against acceptance criteria.
acceptanceCriteria: The first implementation slice is reviewed and validated.
